title.zh: 鸡兔同笼 · 先假设，差额会说话
title.en: Chickens & Rabbits · Assume First, Let the Gap Speak

description.zh: 先假设全是一种，差额除以每换一个的变化量，得到另一种的个数。仅适用于两种对象、每个数量固定且为整数的题。
description.en: Assume everything is one kind; the gap divided by the change per swap gives the count of the other kind. For two kinds with fixed whole-number amounts.

reason.zh: 每换一只总脚数加同样的 2，所以脚数对兔数的图是一条斜线，交点即答案，这就是一次函数的图像。
reason.en: Each swap adds the same 2 feet, so feet against rabbits is a straight line whose crossing is the answer, which is a linear function's graph.

title.zh: 不用方程怎样解鸡兔同笼？
title.en: How do you solve chickens-and-rabbits without algebra?

ask.zh: 先假设全是鸡，算出来的脚数和实际脚数差多少？这个差额从哪里来？
ask.en: Assume they are all chickens first — how many feet short are you, and where does that gap come from?

ask.zh: 每把一只鸡换成一只兔，脚数增加几只？差额除以这个数，得到的是什么？
ask.en: Each time you swap one chicken for one rabbit, how many more feet appear? What does the gap divided by that number give you?

reveal.zh: 差额来自兔子比鸡多的脚；每换一只多 2 只脚，所以差额÷2 就是兔子的只数，剩下的就是鸡。
reveal.en: The gap comes from rabbits having more feet than chickens; each swap adds 2 feet, so gap ÷ 2 is the number of rabbits and the rest are chickens.
